name: Muppim
title: Son of Benjamin
summary: Muppim was one of the sons of Benjamin, Jacob's youngest son. He is mentioned among those who traveled with Jacob and his family down to Egypt during the famine. He is part of the seventy people in Jacob's household who settled in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Muppim is listed among the sons of Benjamin in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Part of Jacob's household in Egypt
keyEvents.description: Muppim was one of the seventy people in Jacob's family who came to Egypt to live there during the famine, as Joseph had arranged.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Benjamin in the census
keyEvents.description: Muppim's descendants are counted as part of the tribe of Benjamin. In Numbers, Shufam (possibly a variant of Muppim) is mentioned among the clans of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's family leaves Canaan
keyEvents.description: The entire household of Jacob, including Muppim, left Canaan for Egypt after an invitation from Joseph, who had become a powerful man in Egypt.
